Fix the entire upper-left hero panel: replace the dark hazy black gradient with perfectly flat WHITE #FFFFFF. Make the huge existing revive wordmark crisp carbon #202124, retaining its red #D92D20 i dot. Both original slogans must be crisp carbon with excellent readability: 'Financiering op het moment dat het telt.' and 'Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit.' Add small title '17 / SCHAKEL' at top-left with generous margin. No glow, blur or gradient behind text. In the upper-right App icon, remove the red square and replace the existing white arch with the EXACT isolated first lowercase r from the complete wordmark directly above it, in solid white centered on the black icon. That r has an upright stem, squared shoulder and quarter-circle inner curve; it must read r, not n. No red accent anywhere on this isolated icon. Preserve all other layout, existing logo geometry, photography, graphic shapes, palette, typography, original slogans and financial applications. Landscape 1536x1024. Do not add any other words or redesign the board.
variants.description: Een hoek en een boog vormen samen een nieuw r-teken. De losse onderdelen worden kaders en uitsneden in de toepassingen.
variants.detail: Title "17 / SCHAKEL". Inspired by the Remedy reference's contrast of a right-angle fragment and a curved arc, but create ORIGINAL revive geometry. First r must be integrated into revive at same x-height: an upright stem and squared shoulder meet a quarter-circle inner transition, separated by one precise negative-space seam. Keep lowercase r unambiguously readable. Do NOT copy the source's exact isolated symbol or set it beside a complete extra revive wordmark. Remaining evive medium-bold clean upright grotesk, slightly more open spacing than Kader; red square i dot. Derived graphic family: one thick right-angle corner, one quarter-circle arc, combined picture-window frames and neat cropped field shapes. Carbon/white with restrained vivid red and steel grey. Palette: "Carbon #202124", "Rood #D92D20", "Wit #FFFFFF", "Staal #8A96A3". Sophisticated financial clarity, not robotics or clinical healthcare. Natural professional business photo. Generous white hero, black reverse/logo specimen, standalone r icon, all foundations and full finance applications. The angle-to-curve relationship should be visible in both first r and graphic shapes.

Include human finance context, no cars/medical/fitness/racing/neon, no stock trading charts, fake trust badges or guarantees. Assertive, precise, legible and trustworthy. Distinct balanced composition with room to breathe, quality contemporary financial brand design.

variants.name: 18 — Anker
variants.description: Een compact, afgerond r-teken met een helder binnenvlak. Zware vormen en ruime toepassingen geven deze richting stabiliteit.
variants.detail: Title "18 / ANKER". Draw inspiration from the latest reference's substantial rounded interlocking mass and crisp negative-space interior. Make an ORIGINAL compact integrated lowercase r for revive: broad rounded-square stem base, firm curved shoulder, clearly open right side and one clean angular inner opening. No duplicate r, no separate LR monogram and do not copy the source emblem. Solid black letter forms, bold upright evive with matching optical weight, red square i dot. r same body height as remaining letters. Graphic language: generous rounded-corner framing blocks, large cropped internal-counter shape, nested corner frames with sharp inner alignment. Calm substantial shapes, not soft bubbly wellness. Palette: "Zwart #151515", "Rood #D92D20", "Perkament #EAE6D1", "Steen #92948A". Strong black/cream editorial identity, warm documentary business photo, highly readable finance proposal and screens. Hero with unusually generous whitespace, one large black geometry crop and complete brand foundations. Stability and strength expressed through mass and proportion.

variants.name: 19 — Samen
variants.description: Twee aansluitende delen vormen één r. De verbinding wordt een terugkerend element in fotokaders en documentvlakken.
variants.detail: Title "19 / SAMEN". Inspired by the reference's two interlocking rounded components, create an ORIGINAL first-r construction for revive using two thick complementary shapes that join into one readable lowercase r. One straight substantial upright, one curved shoulder, divided by a thin meaningful negative seam; both same navy ink so the letter reads as one unit. Do not make LR, copy source symbol, or place an emblem before an extra r. Other evive upright confident slightly wide grotesk, red square i dot. Show isolated r icon and real one-ink logo. Derived interlocking frames and paired curved rectangular shapes form useful photograph windows and proposal covers. Palette: "Navy #16344A", "Rood #D92D20", "Papier #F7F4EC", "Leisteen #8E9DA4". Natural business-owner/adviser meeting photography, trustworthy modern finance with prominent terms/contact sections. Broad navy/white balanced blocks, not pastels, no handshake cliché. Convey connection through precise joining geometry rather than chain links or hearts.

variants.name: 20 — Continu
variants.description: Een doorlopende bocht geeft het r-teken een rustig karakter. Brede hoekvormen verbinden het woordmerk met fotografie, documenten en toepassingen.
variants.detail: Title "20 / CONTINU". Inspired by the reference's rounded return path and assertive mass, create an original folded-contour lowercase r that transitions from a squared upright into a continuous rounded shoulder. A clean small return-shaped negative counter gives it identity while preserving easy reading. Wordmark has a modest forward lean around 8 degrees, robust matching evive, single red square i dot. No LR monogram, no exact copied silhouette, no separate symbol before extra r. Derived thick continuous-corner bands and sweeping rounded 90-degree frame segments organize business photos and document panels; confident and controlled, not car racing or healthcare. Palette: "Bos #1C3933", "Rood #D92D20", "Ivoor #F4F0E3", "Olijfgrijs #929588". Deep rich forest + light ivory with sparse red. Documentary office finance conversation, complete graphic specimens and polished website/mobile/printed proposal. A little forward motion within an enduring solid identity.
